# OptimAI Creative Agents

> Local-first browser AI, creative workflows and a community builder SDK. MIT-licensed JavaScript SDK, version 0.5.0, workspace contract 1.3, 39 reviewed agent templates. Node.js >=20 and modern browsers; no runtime dependencies.

How to work with this SDK:

- A recipe is a portable v1 JSON manifest: a reviewed template ID, approved setting values and a creative brief. It never carries code, model URLs or credentials.
- Scaffold with `npm run create`, validate with `node scripts/verify.mjs path/to/agent.json`, and run `npm test` before proposing a change.
- Import the public subpaths below; each module ships a `.d.mts` declaration beside it. Files without a subpath are internal. `npm run mcp` starts the local stdio MCP adapter.
- Optional peers stay optional and pinned: `@mlc-ai/web-llm@0.2.85`, `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.1.0`, `three@0.186.1`, `mediabunny@1.62.1`. Canvas, catalog, color, crop, verify and beat modules need none.
- Selected media stays on the device. Media generation, accounts and billing belong to the host application, not this SDK.

## Guides

- [Builder guides](docs/README.md): Build a focused creative tool, remix an existing agent, or embed a reviewed runtime in your own application.
- [Create your first recipe](docs/quickstart.md): This guide creates Cloud Companion, a manga-planning recipe based on the reviewed Story Seed template.
- [Agent catalog](docs/catalog.md): Choose a template by the result its reviewed implementation produces.
- [Runtimes and model setup](docs/runtimes.md): Choose the runtime for the result you need.
- [Integrate agents into your application](docs/host-integration.md): A host reads a recipe, validates it, resolves a reviewed implementation and supplies the user's selected inputs.
- [Reusable camera and avatar agents](docs/CAMERA.md): `camera-stage` and `avatar-stage` share portable browser engines.
- [Music and motion engines](docs/MUSIC-MOTION.md): Two browser engines extend the catalog in SDK 0.4.0 / workspace contract 1.2, and run unchanged on workspace contract 1.3.
- [Connect the local MCP adapter](docs/mcp.md): The optional adapter exposes all 39 reviewed templates to an MCP client over local stdio.
- [Share, contribute and prepare for review](docs/release-and-feature.md): The SDK source is public at OptimaiNetwork/optimai-creative-agents.

## Templates

- Canvas (11): `mockup-maker`, `image-finish`, `reference-blend`, `image-grid`, `print-shop`, `title-frame`, `pixel-layout`, `poster-lab`, `transition-lab`, `glitch-cut`, `letter-pose`
- Browser vision (3): `select-and-replace`, `motion-pose`, `face-performance`
- Writing (5): `cast-notes`, `style-brief`, `storyboard-builder`, `prompt-branches`, `story-seed`
- Interactive (6): `music-reactive`, `frame-sculpture`, `camera-stage`, `model-turntable`, `scene-lighting`, `avatar-stage`
- Guided (14): `sketch-to-scene`, `world-finder`, `shot-atlas`, `motion-finish`, `sketch-to-motion`, `dream-signal`, `frame-fit`, `rough-cut`, `rhythm-cut`, `frame-study`, `motion-tracker`, `depth-motion`, `scene-scout`, `scene-remix`

## Optional

- [Full reference](llms-full.txt): every public declaration and guide inlined in one file, for agents that cannot follow links.
- [Recipe skill](skills/build-a-recipe/SKILL.md): step-by-step instructions an AI coding agent can load to build and verify a recipe.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what each release lets builders and creators do.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how new reviewed operations, tests and docs are proposed.
- [Manifest schema](schema/agent-manifest.schema.json): the strict v1 recipe format.
